run_finephrase_generate_data: run the finephrase script to generate a synthetic dataset using optimized Slurm job configuration
launch_template_math: launch a FinePhrase generation run for the math prompt template to create mathematical word problems
launch_template_table: launch a FinePhrase generation run for the table prompt template to extract structured tables from documents
launch_template_faq: launch a FinePhrase generation run for the faq prompt template to create frequently asked questions
launch_template_tutorial: launch a FinePhrase generation run for the tutorial prompt template to produce step-by-step instructional guides
